articles.title: Lebanese military court judge charges 13 people over Hezbollah explosives truck
articles.description: BEIRUT (AP) — A Lebanese military court has charged 13 people in connection with a seized truck carrying explosives belonging to Hezbollah, state media reported on Friday.
